name: Triad Anime Con
blurb: An anime convention with cosplay contests at the Winston-Salem Marriott in Winston-Salem, North Carolina.

editions.evidence: Page title 'Triad Anime Con – March 26th-28th 2027 – Winston-Salem, NC'; location page: 'Winston-Salem Marriott 425 North Cherry Street Winston-Salem, North Carolina'.

notes: Run by the same Carolinas Anime Cons organizer/network as Ichibancon and Colossalcon Virginia -- the homepage promotes a shared 'Southern Season Pass' covering all three 2027 events, and the site reuses Ichibancon-branded logo files. The /all-guests/ page shows only small sponsor/partner-pass graphics (no guest photo cards and no dated 'Guest Announcement' post like Ichibancon had), so guests is 'none-yet' for the 2027 edition.
